title: Akhilesh's Samajwadi Party scores a win in PM Modi’s Varanasi in UP MLC polls
content: The BJP secured four out of eleven seats in the recent Uttar Pradesh Legislative Council elections. Samajwadi Party candidate Lal Bihari Yadav won the Varanasi Teachers' constituency while BJP retained Meerut seats. Tensions arose at counting centers, with allegations of assault and electoral malpractice reported. Akash Agarwal of the SP claimed physical aggression from BJP supporters during the tensions.

title: Three-time Asian Para Games gold medallist Neeraj Yadav dies by suicide
content: Indian para-athletics was left in shock after three-time Asian Para Games gold medallist Neeraj Yadav allegedly died by suicide at a flat on Tuesday night. The 42-year-old, who competed in the F55 category, suspected to have consumed poison. A postmortem examination was underway at Delhi’s GTB Hospital on Wednesday at the time of filing the report.

title: Microsoft employees in India can now opt for a buyout: Who qualifies and what it pays
content: Microsoft is offering buyouts to around 60,000 employees, over a quarter of its workforce, in India, the US, the UK and Canada. HR head Amy Coleman announced the Voluntary Exit Offer in a memo to staff. The package matches standard severance, which can run up to 39 weeks of pay. Xbox, Copilot and Windows teams are eligible, sales is excluded, and the deadline is December.

title: Indiana contractor paid with Ford truck now personally liable for $82,020
content: An Indiana couple successfully secured an $82,020 judgment against a contractor for breach of contract and fraudulent misrepresentations. Tasked with property repairs, the contractor failed to deliver promised materials and left payments for roofing supplies unaccounted for, ultimately leading to a lawsuit. The court held him personally liable, underscoring the importance of accountability in construction agreements and the serious consequences of dishonest practices.

title: 'You can't just go and score': Abhishek Sharma responds to Yuvraj Singh's 12-ball fifty jibe
content: Abhishek Sharma celebrated his century against New Zealand while responding to Yuvraj Singh’s playful reminder. Yuvraj highlighted his record of a 12-ball fifty during the exchange. Nepal's Dipendra Singh Airee set a new record in 2023 with a nine-ball fifty. Abhishek emphasized team goals over personal milestones in his innings. India secured a convincing victory with Abhishek’s performance, leading the series 3-0.

title: Meet 82-year-old Haryana dadi who learnt to ride a bike at 74, drives tractors
content: At 82, Sukhma from Sundana village has become a beacon of inspiration for many. With her grandson's encouragement, she embraced the thrill of motorcycle riding and mastered it, proving that age is merely a number. Not stopping there, Sukhma ventured into driving tractors too. Through her shared experiences on social media, she encourages others to pursue new passions, showing that the pursuit of knowledge and adventure knows no age limits.

title: Japan DNA study finds 126 fish species farther north than previously recorded
content: Japan is witnessing a dramatic transformation in its marine ecosystems as rising ocean temperatures prompt fish species to migrate northward. An extensive research effort involving the analysis of water samples has revealed profound implications for local fisheries, economies, and the overall health of marine life. With the introduction of new species, traditional fishing methods may need to evolve, underscoring the crucial role of environmental DNA in monitoring these biodiversity changes.

title: Zuckerberg & wife give California $50 mn weeks after donation shift announcement
content: In a generous move, Mark Zuckerberg and Priscilla Chan have pledged $50 million to Sacramento State University. The contribution will assist in the conversion of three state office buildings into an innovative campus, enhancing student housing and creating state-of-the-art STEM and AI facilities. This initiative reflects their evolving priorities towards backing biomedical AI research, particularly in light of discussions surrounding a possible wealth tax on California's billionaires.

title: Meet T K Radha: Kerala physicist personally invited to Princeton by Oppenheimer
content: Thayyoor K. Radha's journey as a physicist is a testament to resilience and brilliance. Growing up in a small village in Kerala, she thrived in mathematics and physics, breaking through societal barriers. Her valuable research work earned her an invitation from J. Robert Oppenheimer to the Institute for Advanced Study.

title: Israel election results: With no clear majority in sight, what could happen next?
content: Partial results put Netanyahu’s bloc ahead with 57 seats against 47 for the opposition, while exit polls suggest neither side has a clear path to a parliamentary majority. Arab-led parties could prove crucial in coalition negotiations.

title: ‘Locked car, abuse’: How an Uber ride turned into an ordeal for Gurgaon techie
content: A woman in Delhi experienced a frightening encounter with an Uber driver demanding a higher fare. After refusing to pay the inflated amount, the driver allegedly restrained her and withheld her luggage. The situation escalated as the driver followed her home, threatening her life. Despite her efforts to report the incident, she was unable to access Uber's safety support feature.

title: After Kolkata naked mob justice, cops parade 3 semi-naked to ‘reconstruct crime’
content: In Behala’s Sarsuna, three men faced public humiliation after they were accused of punishing a teenager. The youth was reportedly stripped and paraded at gunpoint for allegedly kissing a 13-year-old girl. Police conducted the parade as part of a crime scene recreation, drawing public attention and filming. Human rights groups criticized the police for resorting to such actions during the arrest.

title: Murder conviction set aside as Jharkhand HC flags trial questioning in English
content: The Jharkhand high court has acquitted a man previously sentenced for murder, citing severe flaws in his trial proceedings. Notably, the court highlighted that the accused was not adequately interrogated about crucial evidence, and his statement was recorded in English without a suitable translation. Additionally, eyewitness accounts were inconsistent, and physical evidence linking him to the crime was lacking.

title: Mitchell Starc equals Dale Steyn, leaves several legends behind in elite list
content: Mitchell Starc made headlines with his stellar 20th five-wicket haul in Test cricket, claiming 6/72 against South Africa. His fiery spell ignited a collapse in the opponent's batting lineup, shifting the momentum dramatically. From a strong position at 203/1, South Africa crumbled to 329 all out, intensifying the series, which now stands at 1-1, underscoring the match's importance.

title: Travis Kelce helps provide 25,000 meals to children through charity effort
content: In 2024, Travis Kelce partnered with breakfast brand Kodiak to donate 25,000 meals to children at Kansas City’s Operation Breakthrough. The contribution came as the nonprofit mourned co-founder Sister Berta, who established the organisation with Sister Corita in 1971. Serving more than 700 children daily, the centre continues their mission of supporting families. Kelce’s donation provided practical help while honouring Sister Berta’s lasting legacy of compassion and community service.

title: Tyreek Hill to Chiefs? Trade rumors grow ahead of NFL deadline
content: The Kansas City Chiefs could consider reuniting with Tyreek Hill as they search for wide receiver help before the NFL trade deadline. Injuries to Rashee Rice and Tyquan Thornton have increased the team's urgency, but trade options remain limited. ESPN insider Adam Schefter confirmed Kansas City has contacted teams about receivers. Hill is nearing the final stages of rehabilitation from a serious knee injury, though his recovery and ability to regain peak form remain concerns.

title: Rs 25,000 crore in taxes, 12 lakh jobs: Vaishnaw backs mobile PLI scheme
content: India's mobile phone manufacturing sector has generated Rs 25,000 crore in direct tax collections and Rs 3,000 crore in GST. Union minister Ashwini Vaishnaw announced new schemes to further enhance production and strengthen global supply chains. The Mobile Phone Manufacturing Scheme will operate from FY 2026-27 to FY 2030-31, with Rs 62,500 crore allocated. It aims to increase domestic sourcing and support Indian mobile brands through incentives.

title: ‘Raped by Rohingya refugees’: Landlord finds woman held captive for 5 months

During her confinement, she was raped multiple times by four men, including one who falsely married her. The case came to light when the landlord forced entry to collect unpaid rent. After hearing about the abuse, the woman’s relatives contacted the police for help. Authorities arrested three suspects while the main accused remains at large.

title: Waited 3 months for silver Royal Enfield, got blue; dealer ordered to pay Rs 28,000
content: A Kerala consumer commission has taken a firm stand against a Royal Enfield dealer for unfair practices following a delayed motorcycle delivery. After an arduous wait of three months, the buyer received a different colored model, compounded by issues reported upon pickup. The ruling mandated the dealer to compensate the complainant with Rs 25,000 plus legal fees, with a strict 30-day timeline for compliance to avoid accruing additional interest.

title: Abhishek Sharma scripts history, breaks Rohit Sharma's all-time world record
content: Abhishek Sharma dazzled in the third T20I against New Zealand, smashing 85 sixes in 2026 and breaking Rohit Sharma's former record of 80 sixes from 2023. His scorching performance, scoring 113 runs off 38 balls, led India to a swift victory, as they chased down New Zealand's 199-run target in just 13.2 overs, securing a commanding 3-0 series advantage.

title: BP Singh death: Shivaji Satam recalls mentor and friend; hails his dedication to CID

His longtime friend and co-star Shivaji Satam expressed profound grief over the loss of a guiding figure, emphasizing Singh's unwavering commitment to his craft despite his health issues. title: We’d rather die than give up land: Siang villagers on proposed dam project

Ongoing protests disrupt agricultural activities, casting doubt on the imminent paddy harvest as the Adi community prioritizes their fight for their ancestral rights over farming needs.

Abhishek Sharma's impressive 113 runs and Vaibhav Sooryavanshi's 45 runs set a strong foundation for the win. The opening duo scored a record 118 runs in the first six overs to dismantle New Zealand's bowling attack. India's bowlers effectively executed yorkers to limit New Zealand to 198 runs after 20 overs.
